prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A bright, modern classroom scene featuring a group of attentive students, all dressed in matching school uniforms consisting of white shirts and dark vests with red accents, seated at desks facing the front of the room. The teacher, a middle-aged man in a dark suit, stands near a large whiteboard, gesturing as he speaks, his posture confident and engaged. The students, mostly young women, are focused on the lesson, some taking notes, others listening intently. The classroom is spacious and well-lit, with large windows along one wall letting in abundant natural light and offering a glimpse of greenery outside. The overall color palette is clean and neutral, dominated by whites, blacks, and subtle pops of red from the uniforms. The composition is shot from the back of the classroom at a slight angle, creating a sense of depth and immersion, with the teacher as the focal point. The atmosphere is studious and orderly, evoking a sense of academic rigor and discipline. The lighting is soft and natural, enhancing the clarity and realism of the scene, while the camera’s perspective places the viewer among the students, heightening the sense of participation and engagement.
